// Banned in every covered test project, i.e. all but Ducky.Concurrency.Tests (SPEC §17.1): a real interleaving
// runs only under the §17.3 harness. The analyzer has no wildcards and silently ignores an ID that resolves to no
// symbol, so each overload is listed by exact documentation ID, generated by test/banned-ids.cs from the SDK reference
// packs and the CsCheck version in Directory.Packages.props (`dotnet run test/banned-ids.cs -- check` fails on a stale
// ID and on a generated ID missing here, e.g. a new Task.Run or CsCheck threads overload). test/Shared/Property.cs
// is the one justified Check.Sample call site.
//
// Beyond the SPEC §17.1 set: every CsCheck.Check runner with a threads parameter, Task.Start, Timer and PLINQ.

// Every CsCheck.Check method with a threads parameter: Sample* (SampleParallel included) goes through Property.Check;
// Faster*, Conform, Equality, Exhaustive and Faults have no gated form.
